about: Hand-written chat messages labelled with the one permission each needs (COD-305). `none`: answered from what the orglet knows; `web`: search or read public web pages; `read`: read files in a folder on this computer; `edit`: change or create files there; `run`: run commands or programs; `browser`: use a website in Orglet's browser (sign in, click, fill a form). `tune` cases chose the wording and the threshold; `held` cases were only scored.
